task.instruction: Check the leaderboard for Golf's DP World Tour in the SPORT section, what was the name of the most recent tournament, and how many teams have a Total of -10 strokes.

final_answer:
On the DP World Tour leaderboard (BBC Sport → Golf → DP World Tour), the most recent tournament listed is the **Genesis Championship**, played 21–25 October 2026 at Woo Jeong Hills CC (par 71, 7,367 yards, $4,000,000 prize money). It was won by Yuto Katsuragawa at 13 under par (271 strokes), with Frederic Lacroix and Martin Couvra tied second at 11 under.

**Players on a Total of -10 strokes: 7.** They were Jorge Campillo (Spain), Antoine Rozner (France), Sang-Hun Shin (South Korea), Casey Jarvis (South Africa), Ryan Fox (New Zealand), Filippo Celli (Italy) and Si-Woo Kim (South Korea) — all tied for fourth at 274 strokes.

(Note: the leaderboard lists individual golfers rather than teams, so the count of 7 refers to players.)

judge.rationale: The BBC DP World Tour leaderboard page shows Genesis Championship and seven entries with Total -10, matching the agent’s answer.
